pages.text: The next day, Julia gets back from class. Her best cup is in bits on the grass.
pages.picture: the next day after class: Julia with her backpack, looking down at her best teacup in pieces on the grass by the playhouse door

pages.text: "Not again, Toby!" Toby just looks sad. Julia sighs.
pages.picture: Julia sighing, eyes rolled up, "not again"; Toby sitting by the playhouse looking sad; the broken teacup pieces on the grass between them

pages.text: Then one day, Julia runs back fast and peeks in at the play house.
pages.picture: another day: Julia tiptoeing fast across the lawn with her backpack on and peeking into the playhouse doorway

pages.text: A big bee buzzes at Toby's nose. Buzz! Buzz!
pages.picture: looking in through the playhouse door: Toby inside among Julia's toys, a fat fuzzy bumblebee buzzing at his nose, Toby going cross-eyed at it

pages.text: Toby gets cross. His spikes stick up.
pages.picture: Toby cross in the playhouse doorway, every spike on his back standing straight up like a porcupine, eyes narrowed at the bee; the toys behind him starting to tremble

pages.text: And then her dolls zoom up, high, high, high! Her drum zooms up. Her tea set zooms up!
pages.picture: the dolls, the toy drum and the tea set shooting straight up out of the playhouse, high into the sky, fast, with whoosh lines; Toby in the doorway, spikes up, cross; Julia on the lawn, frozen, looking up

pages.text: Crash! Bang! Smash! They all come down.
pages.picture: the toys crashing down onto the lawn: the tea set smashing, the drum bouncing, the dolls tumbling, bits everywhere; Julia and Toby ducking
Julia staring, mouth wide open, chin dropped, amazed, not angry; broken toys all over the grass around her

pages.text: "Toby, you did that! That is so, so cool! Do it on me! Make me float!"
pages.picture: Julia jumping up and down with excitement, pointing at Toby; Toby, spikes flat again, startled; broken toys on the grass

pages.text: Toby looks down. "I can not," he said. "I can not help it. I just get upset, and things zoom up and smash."
pages.picture: Toby looking down sadly among the broken toys, a tear on his nose; Julia beside him, listening

pages.text: Julia thinks hard. Then she grins. "Then we will fix it," she said.
pages.picture: Julia with a determined grin and one finger up, she has an idea; Toby looking up at her, a little hopeful
